user.title: Notify Hub
user.description: One action for every notification of the house: routed by presence, quiet hours and priority.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Notify Hub is already set up.

init.title: Notify Hub rules
init.description: Also editable in the Notify Hub panel (Rules and Settings tabs).

data_description.quiet_enabled: Alerts and infos wait for the end of the quiet hours; critical ones go through.
data_description.dedup_minutes: A notification on the same topic within this time is not sent again (0: never ignored).
data_description.digest_times: When the notifications waiting for the digest are sent, as one message.
data_description.escalation_first: A critical notification nobody acknowledged goes again to everyone after this long.
data_description.escalation_second: Then to the SMS service, this long after it was first sent.
data_description.sms_service: Notify service that sends text messages (e.g. notify.free_mobile), for the last escalation step.
data_description.away_mode: With nobody home, infos go to everyone instead of waiting for the digest.

send.name: Send
send.description: Sends a notification through Notify Hub: routed by presence, quiet hours and priority.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: critical: everyone, through the quiet hours, until acknowledged; alert: people at home; info: people at home, or the digest; digest: the next digest.

topic.name: Topic
topic.description: Two notifications on the same topic close together count as one (default: title and message).

people.name: People
people.description: Only these people (default: by priority and presence).

data.name: Data
data.description: Extra data passed to the notify services (mobile app options).

acknowledge.name: Acknowledge
acknowledge.description: Acknowledges a critical notification: no more escalation, cleared on the phones.

send_digest.name: Send the digest
send_digest.description: Sends now what waits for the digest.
